title: Acknowledged delivery and observable retransmit protocol for SIEM/third-party sinks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Define and implement an acknowledged delivery protocol and observable retransmit model for audit sink integrations (Splunk HEC, Datadog Events, generic webhooks). Goal: reduce undetected loss, provide clear SLOs for delivery, and make retries/ordering explicit to downstream customers.
notes: Motivation: customers and SOC teams require bounded risk when forwarding high-value audit events to external SIEMs. Current best-effort webhooks lead to silent drops and confusing forensics.
Scope: protocol and SDK changes for the audit-forwarder service and adapters (Splunk HEC, Datadog, generic webhook). Does NOT include UI changes in Console for now (follow-up PM ticket).

Design constraints: minimal latency increase for P90 path, compatibility with existing tenant-level sinks, no persistent cross-tenant coupling, and ability to operate in Private deployments where third-party endpoints are restricted.

We will support two modes: 'observed at-least-once' with idempotency tokens and reconciliation, and 'ordered per-tenant best-effort' using per-tenant sequence windows. Exactly-once semantics are not guaranteed unless the sink supports ACK+dedup (see adapter variations).
comments: 2025-02-11 - Aisha K: Initial spike complete. Prototype 3-way handshake (INIT, ACK, ACCEPT) works in the local SIEM emulator. Observability hooks emit delivery.latency_ms and delivery.retransmit_count.
2025-02-18 - Miguel S: Implemented idempotency token signing (HMAC-SHA256) and per-record sequence numbers. Pushed draft adapter for Splunk HEC: github.com/redwood-inference/audit-adapters/pull/142
2025-02-20 - SRE review (Jordan Lee): prefer explicit TLV for control frames vs embedding control in HTTP headers to avoid proxy stripping; updated PR accordingly.
2025-02-25 - Security review note (Anita Rao): KMS usage for HMAC keys required for Private customers; added config and rotation plan. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-02-27 - QA: started chaos tests using SIEM emulator that returns intermittent 503 and unordered acks; observed duplicate deliveries when retries aggressive. Tuned backoff and added randomized jitter (0.5-1.5x).
2025-03-01 - PM feedback (Lars Petterson): add tenant-priority watermarks so enterprise tier gets higher allowed throughput during backpressure. Added to design doc and labels.

acceptance_criteria: Protocol defined in Confluence with message sequence diagrams and failure modes
Splunk HEC adapter implements handshake and idempotency token header; PR merged and e2e tests pass
Datadog adapter implements best-effort ACK handling and exposes retransmit_count metric
Audit-forwarder emits delivery.* metrics (latency_ms, retransmit_count, ack_lag) and a per-tenant delivery state dashboard
Runbook updated: steps to investigate sink loss, how to trigger reconciliation, and DLQ inspection
Automated chaos tests covering transient 5xx, long tail timeouts, TCP resets demonstrate <1% undetected loss under default SLO in staging
